content: Ecto.Multi is a pure data structure — no Repo needed to construct. Repo is only required at execution (Repo.transaction(multi)). Key API: Multi.new/0, Multi.insert/3, Multi.update/3, Multi.delete/3, Multi.run/3 (receives {repo, changes_so_far} or {repo, changes}), Multi.merge/2 (dynamic merge via anonymous function), Multi.append/2, Multi.prepend/2, Multi.put/3. On success: {:ok, map_of_results}. On failure: {:error, failed_op_name, reason, changes_so_far}. Composability: build multi in one place, pass as value, merge with another multi before execution. This makes it ideal for a storage adapter to return a multi of write ops that the lifecycle later merges with a checkpoint update multi before calling Repo.transaction.
